summary: Tested bank-withdrawal email_sent flag + new /resend-code endpoint (backend) and StepConfirm warning / ResendCodeButton / DetailModal awaiting_code section (frontend). All backend behaviors verified with Resend quota exhausted (real production condition). Frontend renders warning, resend button, cooldown label, 429 toast correctly. One real UX issue found: the 502 status used for 'email send failed' is intercepted by the Kubernetes ingress which replaces the JSON detail with an HTML 'Bad Gateway' page, so the frontend toast shows empty text instead of the intended message.

minor.issue: Uses HTTP 502 when Resend send fails; the ingress replaces the JSON body ({detail:'No se pudo enviar…'}) with an HTML Bad Gateway page. Frontend cannot surface the error message. Consider changing to 503 or 502 with body pass-through, or better: return 200 with {sent:false, error_code:'email_send_failed'} so the UI can render a proper toast.

ui_bugs.issue: Native <select> options contain <span> wrapping the flag emoji, producing React hydration warnings: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <select>/<option>'. Cosmetic but pollutes console.
When resend-code returns 502 (Resend quota / send failed) the toast text is empty because ingress strips JSON body. See backend minor issue.

action_items: Change resend-code error status from 502 to a non-bad-gateway code (e.g. 503 or 200 with {sent:false, message}) so ingress does not replace the JSON body with HTML; otherwise the frontend cannot render the localized error toast.
Remove <span> wrapper around flag emojis inside <select><option> in BankWithdrawalPage (country + from-currency selects) to eliminate React hydration warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: bank_withdrawals.py initiate: send_email is awaited and email_sent flag reflects real Resend result — correctly surfaces quota errors instead of failing silently. ✓

resend-code correctly rate-limits to 60s, does NOT rotate confirmation_code_hash when send fails, appends failure entry to status_timeline, and burns code on successful send + resets code_attempts & expiry. ✓
resend-code correctly returns 404 for unknown/foreign requests and 400 when status != awaiting_code. ✓
confirm-code flow unchanged; existing code stored in DB still confirms and moves state to conversion_done. ✓

Ingress/Cloudflare intercepts 502 responses — this is a HOSTING constraint, not a code bug per se, but combined with the choice of 502 for a business-level failure it degrades UX. Prefer non-5xx statuses for expected upstream provider errors.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all elements found & interactive; 502 toast body empty due to ingress)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 temp bank_withdrawal_requests during backend test + 1 during UI test (WD-260821-C188F2). All cleaned up (docs deleted, cases deleted, wallet pending decremented). WD-260603-77631D (real admin awaiting_code retiro) was NOT modified beyond a resend attempt which correctly returned 502 without rotating its hash.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_iter69_bank_withdrawal_resend.py. They run for ~70s because they wait 62s to exercise the resend cooldown. Resend daily quota is EXHAUSTED as of the test run, so email_sent will be False and resend-code returns 502; if quota resets tomorrow the happy path branch inside test_resend_after_cooldown covers hash rotation + email_logs 'sent' status.
rca of the issue: Original bug: users' retiros stuck on 'Esperando código' because send_email_background silently swallowed Resend quota errors and there was no resend button. Fix verified: (a) initiate now uses awaited send_email and persists both email_sent flag and email_logs entry (status=failed with 'daily email sending quota' error), (b) frontend renders wd-email-failed-warning + wd-resend-code-btn when email_sent=false, (c) new /resend-code endpoint with 60s rate-limit, atomic hash rotation only on success, 404/400 security checks. Remaining polish: use non-502 status for email send failure to keep JSON body reachable by frontend.
